skills.name: neckbeard
skills.description: The smallest change that is correct, safe at the trust boundary it crosses, fast and scalable at a named load, simple for the end user, and finishes the paths it creates. Levels: lite, full (default), paranoid, off.

skills.name: neckbeard-review
skills.description: Review a change for correctness, the trust boundary, speed and scale at the named load, whether internal complexity is hidden behind a simple user experience, and whether the change is finished. Supports --ci JSON gate mode.

skills.name: neckbeard-audit
skills.description: Audit a repository or folder for the Safe, Fast at the named load, and Done gates starting at entry points. Modes: lite (targeted execution flows and major data/trust boundaries) or complete (every code, config, and doc file).

skills.name: neckbeard-debt
skills.description: Ledger of every accepted risk and deliberate shortcut marked with a risk:, shortcut:, or ponytail: comment, flagging illegal-deferral, expired-load-trigger, no-trigger, no-reason, and unrecorded-decision.

skills.name: neckbeard-gain
skills.description: 100% local telemetry report and HTML dashboard for NeckBeard: tokens used, cost, turn performance, definition reuse %, refactor line deltas, PreToolUse guard blocks, and VIBES (.ai-audit/) PRISM/TRACE health.
